notes.title: [Warning] Players using Hacking Tool
notes.notes:
Dear SOF Players,

We are issuing an important announcement regarding player security and the use of unauthorized programs.
We have recently received multiple reports of players using third-party software and hacking tools, which is a direct violation of our game policy.

The use of illegal programs is strictly prohibited. Our team is dedicated to creating a fair and balanced environment for all players,
and any unfair advantage undermines the integrity of the game.

[b]Please consider this a final warning.[/b]

After this notice, we will be taking strong and immediate action against any account found to be using or providing unauthorized software.
There will be no exception with violating the game policy. We highly suggest players to delete the illegal programs/third-party software/hacking tools.

Additionally, for your own security, we strongly advise you to avoid and not download programs from any illegal websites.
Doing so could compromise your account and personal information.

We will continue to do our best to maintain a fair and enjoyable gaming environment for everyone.
We appreciate your cooperation and your commitment to fair play.

Regards,
SOF Team

confirming that drops are random and fairly distributed among factions. The drop system is entirely managed by the server,
with no manual interference or faction-based adjustments.

Since misinformation and repeated false claims can result in a negative influence on the SOF community and harm other players,
we would sincerely request your cooperation in refraining from this activity and maintaining a fair and respectful environment.

※ Please be aware that Netgame highly suggests players avoid following activities as it can lead to penalties.

📌 Check details of Rules of Conduct.
💻 https://www.netgame.com/rules/rules_of_conduct.mgame

In addition, to manage tickets with efficiency GMs will not respond to tickets
that include rumors or comments spamming. Tickets can be closed without notice.

📌 See full details on our Official Website.

Best Regards,
SOF Team

notes.title: [Policy on Multi Client]
notes.notes:
Dear SOF Community,

We hope this message finds you well. 
We are writing to inform you about an important update to our policy regarding Multi-Client usage in Scions of Fate, aimed at enhancing your gaming experience.

● Basic Policy:

The core policy remains unchanged. A pop-up message will still appear when attempting to open more than the allowed number of clients.

• IP: Maximum of 5 clients
• PC: Maximum of 2 clients

This policy is in place to prevent potential issues related to account spamming, abuse, or hacking incidents. 
We appreciate your understanding in this matter.

Similar to our handling of VPN usage, which is categorized as an unsupported issue, Multi-Client usage will be treated in the same manner.

● Policy Changes:

Previously, exceeding the allowed number of clients resulted in automatic penalties. However, based on player feedback, we understand that this has caused difficulties, especially for those engaging in party play. Therefore, we will no longer penalize players for using Multi-Client as long as it does not negatively impact the game environment.

● Important Notes:

• We strongly discourage the use of third-party programs or bypassing internet restrictions, as these actions can lead to negative consequences.
• If a player creates multiple accounts to exploit the game system or abuses game mechanics, we will ban the account and IP address.
 
Please note that issues arising from the use of Multi-Client may be classified as "unsupportable issues."

● Exceptions:

While we will not actively sanction Multi-Client usage, if this allowance is abused (e.g., excessive client usage or monopolizing hunting grounds), players will face penalties.

● For Players Previously Banned:

If you were banned for Multi-Client issues, please submit a ticket. We will investigate and unban accounts that did not cause harm or violate rules. This does not guarantee an automatic unban.

We hope these changes will enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for being a valued member of our community.

Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Sincerely, 
SOF Team

notes.title: [Notice] About [Bugs]Natural Low Grade Soul Stone
notes.notes:
Dear SOF Community!

We got feedback that due to the [Bug] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone item, 
players are experiencing inconvenience in using the item through the 
'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' quest.

Therefore, to address the issue where the [Bug] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone 
disappears without any effect when used, we plan to change this bugged item to a regular item 
and skip the process of changing it to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).

As result, after the maintenance on 12/06/2023, 
the quest 'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' will be removed from NPC Woody's quest list, 
and the [Bugs] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone item will be changed to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).
Additionally, an abnormal success rate has been identified, promoting a slight adjustment accordingly.

Thus, players who wish to exchange items through the quest are recommended to exchange 
all [Bugs] Natural Low Grade Soul Stone items through Woody's quest before 12/06/2023 at 18:00 PM (PST).

※Note!
- The quest 'Exchange of Unserviceable Event Item' will be removed after the 12/06/2023 maintenance.
- After the 12/06/2023 maintenance, [Bugs] Natural Grade Soul Stone will be changed to Low Grade Soul Stone (Natural).
- After the 12/06/2023 maintenance, an abnormal enhancement success rate will be slightly adjusted.

Best Regards,
SOF Team

notes.title: [Notice] About logging in during maintenance.
notes.notes:
Dear SOF Community,

When we announce that players should log out during maintenance checks,
Whenever we announce that players should log out during maintenance checks,
there are some players who don't follow this instruction and remain logged in.
Thin can cause disruptions during maintenance and can even extend the maintenance period.

We understand that some players want to log in quickly to take their spot on hunting grounds.
However, there are some players who take advantage of the maintenance process
by logging in secretly and trying to exploit it.

To provide better service to players without affecting maintenance, 
we have to take strong measures against this behavior.
We kindly ask for your understanding.

We have issued a one-day ban on all players who attempted to log in 
during the maintenance on May 10th as a warning.
We have unbanned the accounts a little earlier than one full day.

Players who were blocked due to this issue can now log in again.

Logging in during maintenance is prohibited, and we kindly ask that you
log in only after the maintenance completion announcement is made.

We will always do our best to maintain a clean and fair community for the SOF players.

Best Regards,
SOF Team

notes.title: Announcement
notes.notes:
[Reminder] 

We're informing the current events surrounding Netgame, Inc. 
Netgame has been part of a global company called “SmartBig Corp.”. 
The stakeholder of Netgame, Inc. has been SmartBig Cooperation since the start and till now. 
By law starting from July 1st, 2022, we have to label any documentation or 
legal-wise content with our stakeholder’s name “Smart-Big Cooperation”. 
Due to this action, we have to notify and also need users to renew their User Agreement. 
This may be burdening and may cause a hassle.
Bt please take your time renewing your user policy agreements with us. 
Listed below are the highlights and summaries please read it carefully to 
fully understand the closure of this situation.
 
1. Everyone who logs in from July 1st should acknowledge and 
accept alternation of the Terms of Agreement of Netgame Inc. 
This is to continue participating and being part of Netgame’s games and agreeing to the policy 
regarding the product of his/her account to the Netgame service in North America. 
Starting from [u][i]25nd of July 2022[/i][/u], Updated User Agreement & Privacy Policy 
will be up as a pop-up window once you log into your account via the official website.
We encourage you to review the changes in the User Agreement and Privacy Policy and 
want you to make sure to confirm these changes as soon as possible. 
Please be informed that, as of 16th of August, those who have not confirmed/accepted 
the updated version of User Agreement and Privacy Policy, 
account status will be changed to “PENDING”. Account reactivation process is to simply accept the changes in policy on the official website. We highly recommend that you proceed with agreeing 
to the change in policy in advance to avoid account inactivation issue. 
 
2. Any contents with reference to your items, cash, and contents will be untouched. 
Any cash / Ingame gold / Game Items will not be needed to be transferred due to no alteration happening regarding games and publishing.
 
3. All the current staff / same publisher will remain the same. 
We are still Netgame however have to label documentation in our Stakeholder’s name 
“SmartBig Corp.” due to legal reasons. Just note that SmartBig was our major stakeholder 
since the opening of Netgame Inc.

4. Lastly if the Privacy Policy / User Agreement has not been accepted aforementioned your account will go to ‘Pending Status’. If you do not finish the agreement by logging in to our website and accepting it, your account will not be able to enter our games from [b]August 16th 2022 [/b]until accepted. Please complete this your account restrained from connecting into our games.
We thank you for your loyalty to Netgame. Again, nothing will be changed except that the labelings 
of names presented in documentation and website have to be presented as “SmartBig”. 
We appreciate your endorsement of us and we shall proceed to becoming a better and 
progressing company.

Thanks & Best Regards from all Netgame Staff.

notes.title: [Notice] DD and Party-time Event Renewal
notes.notes:
[Notice] DD and Party-time Event Renewal

Dear SOF Community!

We had opened a Forum to hear feedback from our valuable players for an issue of 
"DD and Party-time event" last month. 

After a continuous argument and discussion with our team, the Dev team insist on
 closing DD and PTE event, but long story short, we decided to continue providing DD and PTE events.
However, for many reasons - new content update and holding various events in the future 
- reducing the percentage of the events will be inevitable.

The new version of the DD & PTE event will start on August 1st.

a) Weekend DD Event
-  Before: Every Weekend
- After: Once a month > SOF Weekend (Last weekend of the month)

b) PTE Event
- After: Percentage will be reduced compared before

Once again, thank you all for sharing small and big suggestions, ideas, and feedback with our team.
We will be bringing new content, events soon and hope it could satisfy our players. If you have more feedback good or bad, please feel free to share with us.

We much appreciate your support.

Sincerely,
SOF Team

notes.title: [Remind] Warning False Report Issue
notes.notes:
Dear, SOF

Recently, we are receiving ticketes that certain players are spreading false information on [b]SOF staffs again[/b].

Since this activity can result in a negative influence on SOF community, we would like to inform players that

[olist]
[*] [b][i]GMs do not ban a player without clear evidence.[/i][/b]
[*][b] [i]GMs do not "give" items to players for personal benefit.[/i][/b]
[/olist]
[b]Players will receive items from GMs ONLY when there is:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b][i]rollback due to system error[/i][/b]
[*] [b][i]hacking/scamming incident[/i][/b]
[/list]

[b]Please be aware that Netgame highly suggests players avoid following activities as it can lead to penalties.[/b]


[list]
[b]
[*] 17. Members may not Engage in any "disruptive behavior" that is deemed to
include, but is not limited to, conduct that purposely interferes with the normal
 flow of game-play or interferes with the usage of other Members use and their
 enjoyment the Games.
 
[*] ii) Behavior: Behavior that intentionally detracts from others' enjoyment (such
 as harassment, Insulting Netgame image, racism, insults, sexual verbal insult
 etc.) is unacceptable. We expect our players to treat each other with respect,
 and promote an enjoyable environment. Acceptable behavior is determined
 by player reports and Netgame's decision, and violating these guidelines will
 result in the account and gameplay restrictions.
 
[*] vii) False report: While we encourage you to report players that are behaving in a disrespectful manner, falsely eporting another player with the sole intent of restricting their gameplay is also unacceptable and will result in penalties to your account.
 
[*] viii) Spamming: Spamming can lead to penalties.
 (REFUSING TO ACCEPT MANAGEMENT JUDGEMENT, SENDING TICKETS
 OVER AND OVER AGAIN, ETC)[/b]
[/list]

[u]In addition, to manage tickets with efficiency GMs will not respond to tickets
that include rumors on GM without enough evidence. Tickets can be closed without notice.[/u]

Regards
Wingback

We hope players are enjoying the journey to ASC 4 so far.

GMs are currently scheduled on a developers conference
meeting this week.

The main purpose of our conference meeting will be a
discussion about the topic of major current issues which
needs to be concentrated on.

In order for us to increase the quality of our games,
we believe it is important to take this opportunity to meet
developers and discuss future plans for our game.

However, this meeting will need traveling that time will be
consumed during the process.

Thus, it is very unfortunate to inform you that the lounge
ticket reply will be delayed.

We sincerely apologize for this issue and highly suggest
for players to send us a ticket next week.

Thanks to all your support, our user capacity has increased
and many potential growth factors are also rising.

Once again, we appreciate your kind understanding and
hoping for having a great week.

───────────────────────────────────────
[h1]▣ Details[/h1]

[list]
[*] Lounge ticket reply will be delayed until next Monday.
[/list]
───────────────────────────────────────

Regards
GM Team

notes.title: [Notice] Warning to Hack Abusers
notes.notes:
Dear, SOF community!

Recently, we have enhanced the security program of Xigncode in order to protect players against hack abusers.

Any player who uses 3rd party program will be automatically blocked by XIGNCODE.

As stated in the "Rules of Conduct", Third Party Programs are not allowed in Netgame. 

Using Third Party Programs is a serious breach of the Netgame policy and players found to be using Third Party Programs such as hack, macro or Third party-bot will be receiving the appropriate penalties by GMs.

If you are currently using any 3rd party program, Netgame highly suggests you to delete the 3rd party program to prevent this kind of inconvenience experience.

Netgame will not take any action to unban hack abusers account. Even if we held the re-investigation event, hackers account will not be included in the investigation process. 

If anyone suspects a character is using illegal automated programs, please try to report it with screenshot clearly showing the character and character's nickname that you suspect as they exhibit the behavior. If you are able please link to any video you may have recorded of this behavior as well.

Netgame can promise you that we wish for the SOF community to be respectful and fair for every player.
Any type of act or behavior deemed inappropriate by Scions of Fate will be dealt with fairness and accordingly.

For full details on what is allowed and disallowed, please follow the link below and read them if necessary.

http://www.netgame.com/rules/rules_of_conduct.mgame

Thank you.

Regards
Wingback

players showing abusing activities in Authority Clash.

that few of the players have been advantaged by  "abusing" 
the system which is considered "unfair".

as below:

[i]i) Cheating: You are responsible for how you and 
your account are represented in the game.

of the game, [u]exploiting bugs, or 

engaging in any activity that grants an unfair 
advantage is considered cheating. [/u]

Exploiting other players is an equally serious offense. 
Scamming, account sharing, and anything else that 
may degrade the gaming experience for other players 
will receive appropriate penalties. [/i]

Thus, this is a warning notice to players that If a player 
who is found showing suspicious activity including abusing 
in-game (logging into 2 different accounts which are order/chaos 
and kill each other in order to fraud score and earn points unfairly), 
we will ban all the related accounts and IP address from 9/03.

at least for a week. However, if the player repeatedly shows
the action, he/she will be permanently be banned.

please do not hesitate to share it with us.

notes.title: [Notice] DamHwaLyn Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, SOF Community![/h1]


Finally, after months of waiting, new character [b]“DamHwaLyn”[/b] has arrived! 

Much appreciate SOF players for waiting her.

“DamHwaLyn” is the main female character of Scions of Fate 
and a best friend of Hanbia, using “Death Flower Leaf Sword”. 
This character shows better evasion than the Sword.

Now, let’s find out more about her😊

[h1]Create Character[/h1]

We should create “DamHwaLyn” character in advance.
Log in to our server and create DamHwaLyn.

▼ In the beginning, DamHwaLyn’s stat will be ideal to the sword-class character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/cfb5c07ee4c47d75abf07c2121b54c6138fe414d.png[/img]

▼ Give your character a name and get ready to start!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/85ab4493d8d6f61cbea8ee59b1079dc45152680d.png[/img]

[h1]Weapon (Death Flower Leaf Sword)[/h1]

Hero class Damhwalyn will only be using its own weapon, 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” just like Hanbia character.

Please keep in mind that exchanging, selling or discarding 
“Death Flower Leaf Sword” will not be allowed. 

After character promotions, you will be able to upgrade the weapon 
through completing its own quests and the quests can be received from NPC Chan.

Whenever it levels up, “Death Flower Leaf Sword” will change its appearance 
and increase its attack rate. However, it has special enhance conditions to level up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/6a507808f2adf1a00a018655d45adb3e5d65edaf.png[/img]

The item, “Heavenly Protection Pill” can be obtained by completing the Quest, 
“King Mandock Heavenly Protection Pill(HanBiGwang)” from NPC GunWoo from Southern Forest.

▼ Death Flower Leaf Sword(8th) (True) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/7befdd0988e5fc81947bc5463ea875abaaf6a594.png[/img]

[h1]Skill[/h1]

Players can learn skills and make it stronger when the character levels up.
However, if you haven’t mastered the first skill, the following skills 
will not be able to be learned. In particular, Damhwalyn can register combo 
at the bottom of the Skill Window like below: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/89f30a516fdd9187475b697ddcb5bf145225e4c2.png[/img]

Combo activates by certain percentages while hunting monsters.
For “ALL KILL”, simply press the activated comments in order 
and you’ll get much Exp and gold!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/b4b0e7e8a67f6ddb084350050facaf2ae7c84239.png[/img]

[h1]Ability[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/4aed2ccf38ed40b93add477937657475f2c3c445.png[/img]

[h1]Promotion[/h1]

Promotion for Damhwalyn will be different from usual promotion system on SOF.
Players can meet characters from the original cartoon-like Hanbia character does.

Promotion quests for Damhwalyn are available at “Space-Time Gate”.
( Except 2nd and 3rd promotion quests.)

“Space-Time Gate” is located near NPC Sky Ryu in Central Valley. 
Players can easily find the place by simply clicking the red dot, “Space-Time Gate”.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/2b2597a3707420ce3e70bfdec9859a68daf045ac.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/8562dfc1e0715478c6c0234dc80fdd9ee5a5cbdf.png[/img]

[b]※ Last notice![/b]

Please be aware that the items below will not be able to use in-game.

a. Training Marble[Nidana]
b. Forgotten Title Abstract(weapon) / Forgotten Title Abstract(Cloth)
c. Glorious Title Abstract(Cloth) / Glorious Title Abstract(weapon) 

Thank you very much for reading the notice 
and once again much appreciate SOF players patience on this update. 

As always, we will do our best to make SOF better environment.

If you have any questions or problems regarding new update, 
please don’t hesitate to send us tickets. 

We look forward to hearing feedbacks or questions from players😊

▷ [url=http://fate.netgame.com/notice/view.mgame?ccode=1&idx=5044] Dan Hwa Lyn Preview [/url]


Best Regards
SOF Team

notes.title: [Notice] New Updates Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Greetings to all players in Scions of Fate![/b][/h1]

 
We thank you all for the continuous love for [b]Scions of Fate[/b].

As many of you've already known, we are going to have big patch
on this month(June) and we are going to upload details about the 
new character and special in-game events.

Once again, we are happy to announce the arrival of our newest character, [b][u]Dam Hwa Lyn[/u]![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31310500/bb185e435f14e340cdfa7ca50dcb34d9492f4dba.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to try out Dam Hwa Lyn ?

Get her up to speed with the Dam Hwa Lyn Celebration Events.

For a limited time, complete the missions in Central Valley, 
and level up your character to receive a special gift!

As you level up your character, you’ll unlock new skills! 
These powerful skills increase as you level up!

Read on for more details about upcoming events.

──────────────────────────────────────────────

[h1]★SOF Unity Event[/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/12/2018 ([b]2 Weeks[/b])
- Quest: [SOF Unity] SOF Unity!
- Accept the Quest from Lady Tae in Central valley. Collect quest
  items by hunting monsters Level ± 10 from your character.

[h1]★Reach Level Up Event![/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/26/2018 ([b]1 Month[/b])
- Quest: Mastering Yourself
- Accept the challenge from Lady Tae and reach the required level. 
  Qualified players will get the chance to complete this easy, 
  exclusive quest as they reach the level milestones.
  Earn lots of useful items on your way to the top!

[h1]★Enhanced Double Down Event![/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/26/2018 ([b]1 Month[/b])
- Take advantage of Double Down time every weekend and train 
  your characters without difficulty!
  ([b]Item/Ki/Exp/Gold +100% > Item/Ki/Exp/Gold +200%[/b])

[h1]★ATK/DEF Boost Event![/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/26/2018 ([b]1 Month[/b])
- All players will be able to gain additional [b]ATK[/b] and [b]DEF[/b].

[h1]★Success Rate Event![/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/26/2018 ([b]1 Month[/b])
- Upgrade your item and get the strongest weapon in the game.

h1]★GMs Screenshot Event![/h1]

- Period: 06/28/2018 – 07/05/2018 ([b]1 Week[/b])
- Chance to Get a Gift! It’s time for you to flourish your artistic 
  creativity! 
  Create New Character and take a Screenshot!
  ☞ [url=https://www.facebook.com/ScionsOfFate]Scions Of Fate Official Page[/url]

[h1]▷Ascension 4th Job [Coming Soon][/h1]

Ascension 4th job for every class will be updated!

[h1]▷Burning Summer Event! [Coming Soon][/h1]

More exciting events are coming up!
Event schedule will be updated on our website as events are finalized.

──────────────────────────────────────────────

We look forward to seeing all of you back in game and hope 
you enjoy the update :)

If you have any questions about new update, we are very happy to 
answer any questions you may have.

Best Regards,
Akio Steam Moderator.

notes.title: Steam Payment Policy Update
notes.notes:
Dear SOF community!

We have important announcement to make about our Steam payment system. 

In an effort to avoid chargeback issue that we have received recently, we will be changing the conditions of Steam payment.

Players will now have to meet the following conditions in order to avoid any potential nCash Chargeback abuse,
 
- Player Level 60 or more will be able to purchase nCash through Steam
- Player Level less than 60 will not be able to purchase nCash through Steam

Much appreciate your kind understanding of change in Steam payment policy.

Regards
Shadow
